⸻

Minimal Working Lagrangian

\boxed{
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal{L}
&= \mathcal{L}{\text{fol}} + \mathcal{L}{\theta} + \mathcal{L}{\text{gauge}} + \mathcal{L}{\text{ferm}} + \mathcal{L}{\text{top}}
\\[6pt]
\mathcal{L}{\text{fol}}
&= \lambda\!\left((\partial T)^2+1\right)
	•	c_1\,(\partial_\mu u_\nu)(\partial^\mu u^\nu)
	•	c_2\,(\partial_\mu u^\mu)^2
\\[6pt]
\mathcal{L}{\theta}
&= \tfrac{1}{2}\,\Delta^{\mu\nu}\partial\mu\theta_4\,\partial_\nu\theta_4

	•	\tfrac{1}{2}(u^\mu\partial_\mu\theta_4)^2
	•	\mu^2\cos\!\big(3\theta_4\big)
\\[6pt]
\mathcal{L}{\text{gauge}}
&= -\tfrac{1}{4}\sum_I F^I{\mu\nu}F^{I\,\mu\nu}
\\[6pt]
\mathcal{L}{\text{ferm}}
&= \sum_a \bar\psi_a\!\left(i\gamma^\mu\partial\mu - m_a(\theta_4)\right)\psi_a
	•	\sum_{a,I} g_I\,\bar\psi_a\gamma^\mu A^I_\mu T^I\psi_a
\\[6pt]
\mathcal{L}{\text{top}}
&= \tfrac{\kappa}{32\pi^2}\,\theta_4 \sum_I F^I{\mu\nu}\tilde F^{I\,\mu\nu}
\end{aligned}}

⸻

Definitions
	•	u_\mu \equiv -\dfrac{\partial_\mu T}{\sqrt{-(\partial T)^2}}, unit timelike vector.
	•	\Delta^{\mu\nu} \equiv \eta^{\mu\nu} + u^\mu u^\nu, projector onto spatial directions.
	•	\tilde F^{\mu\nu} = \tfrac{1}{2}\epsilon^{\mu\nu\rho\sigma}F_{\rho\sigma}.
	•	\theta_4 is 2\pi/3-periodic.
	•	Fermion masses m_a(\theta_4) must respect the discrete symmetry, e.g. m_{0a} + y_a \sin^2\theta_4.

⸻

Why this is “lean but viable”
	•	Foliation sector: just enough to define the preferred time direction and stabilize fluctuations.
	•	\theta_4: periodic scalar with discrete symmetry and minimal kinetic structure.
	•	Gauge fields: standard Yang–Mills.
	•	Fermions: Dirac fields with mass modulated by \theta_4, plus gauge interactions.
	•	Topological term: axion-like coupling of \theta_4 to F\tilde F.

⸻

This compact form is the core TOE candidate. Everything else in the big “beast” version (higher-spatial-derivative regulators, LV-suppressed operators, etc.) can be added back if you want UV completion or to explore phenomenological corrections.

OPERATORS MANUAL — MASTER LAGRANGIAN (FOLIATION + AXION + YM + FERMIONS + TOPOLOGY)
==================================================================================

Central Clean Lagrangian
------------------------
We work in flat spacetime (η = diag(−,+,+,+)). The preferred foliation is defined
by a scalar T(x), with unit-timelike vector u^μ = −∂^μ T / sqrt(−(∂T)^2).
Projector onto spatial slices: Δ^{μν} = η^{μν} + u^μ u^ν.

The clean Lagrangian is:

  L = L_fol + L_theta + L_gauge + L_ferm + L_top

with components:

  L_fol =
    λ ((∂T)^2 + 1)
    + c1 (∂_μ u_ν)(∂^μ u^ν)
    + c2 (∂_μ u^μ)^2
    + (tilde c3 / M_u^2)(Δ^{αβ} ∂_α ∂_β u_μ)^2

  L_theta =
    (Z_⊥/2) Δ^{μν} ∂_μ θ4 ∂_ν θ4
    − (Z_∥/2)(u^μ ∂_μ θ4)^2
    − μ^2 cos(3 θ4)
    + (1 / (2 M_θ^2)) (Δ^{μν} ∂_μ ∂_ν θ4)^2

  L_gauge =
    − 1/4 Σ_I F^I_{μν} F^{I μν}
    + (ζ_F / 2M_F^2) Σ_I (Δ^{μα} Δ^{νβ} F^I_{μν} F^I_{αβ})

  L_ferm =
    Σ_a ψ̄_a (i γ^μ ∂_μ − m_a(θ4)) ψ_a
    − Σ_{a,I} g_I ψ̄_a γ^μ A^I_μ T^I ψ_a
    + Σ_a (ε_a / M_ψ) u_μ ψ̄_a γ^μ ψ_a

  L_top =
    (κ / 32π^2) θ4 Σ_I F^I_{μν} ˜F^{I μν}

Definitions
-----------
- u_μ: preferred timelike unit vector, derived from T.
- Δ^{μν}: spatial projector orthogonal to u^μ.
- θ4: periodic scalar (periodicity 2π/3), potential V(θ4) = μ^2 cos(3θ4).
- m_a(θ4): fermion mass function, respecting discrete symmetry, e.g. m0a + y sin^2 θ4.
- F^I_{μν}: gauge field strengths, with ˜F^I the dual tensor.
- κ: quantized coefficient for axion-like topological term.
- M_•: suppression scales for higher-spatial-derivative operators.

Operator Levels
---------------
We classify operators into levels:

- A (Core): required by symmetries and IR viability (foliation basis, scalar θ4 kinetic & potential, YM, fermion kinetic/gauge, topological axion term).
- B (Soft/technically natural): spurionic Lorentz-violating terms (e.g., u·J for fermions). Allowed, but numerically small; radiatively stable if symmetry protected.
- C (UV regulators): higher-spatial-derivative operators, suppressed by heavy scales. Important for UV stability but negligible in IR.
- D (Topological/discrete): quantized or cohomological terms (axion F ˜F, lattice/BF structures). Invisible in perturbation theory but crucial for global consistency.

Constraint Anchors
------------------
- GW170817: gravitational-wave speed matched to c = 1 → imposes c1 + c3 ≈ 0 (|cT − 1| < 10^-15).
- Solar-System & Pulsars: constrain c2, c4 to |c| ≲ 10^-5–10^-7.
- SME Photon LIV: birefringence bounds |δc/c| down to 10^-15–10^-32 → ζ_F/M_F^2 suppressed.
- SME Fermion LIV: atomic clocks/comagnetometers bound LV currents at 10^-20–10^-30 → ε_a tiny.
- Axion-photon coupling: CAST, PDG: g_{aγγ} ≲ few × 10^-11 GeV^-1 for light axions.
- EDMs: electron EDM |d_e| < 1.1 × 10^-29 e·cm; neutron EDM |d_n| < 1.8 × 10^-26 e·cm.

Usage Guidelines
----------------
- Always enforce u^2 = −1 via λ term.
- Keep Core (A) operators active; include Soft (B) with small coefficients; include UV (C) with large suppression scales; always retain Topological (D).
- When adding gravity, promote η → g, ∂ → ∇, and use Einstein–Æther/Hořava basis (c1–c4 with c13=0).

Baseline Settings
-----------------
- Foliation: c1 + c3 = 0; scan c2, c4 in allowed wedge.
- Scalar θ4: Z_⊥ ≈ Z_∥ in IR; μ set by axion mass or defect tension.
- Gauge: ζ_F → 0 in IR (set M_F large).
- Fermion: ε_a ≈ 0 in IR (set small at matching scale).
- Topological: κ quantized, consistent with anomaly cancellation.

Operator Catalog
----------------
(see constraint_table_master_expanded.csv for full detail: sector, operator, symmetry,
dimensionality, phenomenology, bounds, and baseline setting).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This manual is a living document. Update experimental anchors regularly (PDG,
SME tables, GW observations, EDM bounds, CAST/helioscopes). Keep all symmetry-
allowed operators in the basis; prune only true redundancies (via IBP, EOM, or
constraints).

# Create a concise LaTeX snippet that embeds the Standard Model into the user's framework
latex = r"""
\documentclass[preview]{standalone}
\usepackage{amsmath, amssymb}
\begin{document}
\section*{SM embedding in foliation + axion framework (flat spacetime)}
\noindent
IR limit assumes approximate Lorentz invariance: $c_1 + c_3 \!=\! 0$, $|c_2|,|c_4|\!\ll\!1$; set $\zeta_F/M_F^2,\ \varepsilon_a/M_\psi \to 0$.
\\[4pt]
\textbf{Field content:} Standard Model gauge group $G_{\rm SM}=SU(3)_c\times SU(2)_L\times U(1)_Y$, chiral fermions $q_L,u_R,d_R,\ell_L,e_R$ (and $\nu_R$ optional), Higgs doublet $H$ (hypercharge $+1/2$), plus foliation clock $T$ and periodic scalar $\theta_4$ (period $2\pi/3$).
\\[6pt]
\textbf{Lagrangian:}
\begin{align}
\mathcal{L} &\;=\; \mathcal{L}_{\text{fol}} + \mathcal{L}_{\theta} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{gauge}}^{\rm SM} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{ferm}}^{\rm SM} + \mathcal{L}_{H} + \mathcal{L}_{Y} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{top}}^{\rm SM}\,.
\\[4pt]
\mathcal{L}_{\text{fol}} &\;=\; \lambda\!\left((\partial T)^2+1\right)
+ c_1(\partial_\mu u_\nu)(\partial^\mu u^\nu)
+ c_2(\partial_\mu u^\mu)^2
+ \frac{\tilde c_3}{M_u^2}\!\left(\Delta^{\alpha\beta}\partial_\alpha\partial_\beta u_\mu\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\theta} &\;=\; \frac{Z_\perp}{2}\Delta^{\mu\nu}\partial_\mu\theta_4\partial_\nu\theta_4
- \frac{Z_\parallel}{2}(u^\mu\partial_\mu\theta_4)^2
- \mu^2\cos(3\theta_4)
+ \frac{1}{2M_\theta^2}\!\left(\Delta^{\mu\nu}\partial_\mu\partial_\nu\theta_4\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{gauge}}^{\rm SM} &\;=\; -\frac14 G^A_{\mu\nu}G^{A\mu\nu}
- \frac14 W^I_{\mu\nu}W^{I\mu\nu}
- \frac14 B_{\mu\nu}B^{\mu\nu},
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{ferm}}^{\rm SM} &\;=\; \sum_{\text{gen}}\Big[\,
\bar q_L i\slashed{D} q_L + \bar u_R i\slashed{D} u_R + \bar d_R i\slashed{D} d_R
+ \bar\ell_L i\slashed{D} \ell_L + \bar e_R i\slashed{D} e_R
+ \bar\nu_R i\slashed{D}\nu_R \Big] ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_H &\;=\; (D_\mu H)^\dagger(D^\mu H) - \lambda_H\!\left(H^\dagger H - \tfrac{v^2}{2}\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_Y &\;=\; - \bar q_L Y_u \tilde H u_R - \bar q_L Y_d H d_R - \bar \ell_L Y_e H e_R
- \tfrac12\, \bar \nu_R^c M_R \nu_R - \bar \ell_L Y_\nu \tilde H \nu_R + \text{h.c.}\,,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{top}}^{\rm SM} &\;=\; \frac{\kappa_3}{32\pi^2}\,\theta_4\, G^A_{\mu\nu}\tilde G^{A\mu\nu}
+ \frac{\kappa_2}{32\pi^2}\,\theta_4\, W^I_{\mu\nu}\tilde W^{I\mu\nu}
+ \frac{\kappa_1}{32\pi^2}\,\theta_4\, B_{\mu\nu}\tilde B^{\mu\nu}\,.
\end{align}
\textbf{Definitions:} $u_\mu = -\partial_\mu T / \sqrt{-(\partial T)^2}$, $\Delta^{\mu\nu}=\eta^{\mu\nu}+u^\mu u^\nu$, $\tilde X^{\mu\nu}=\tfrac12\epsilon^{\mu\nu\rho\sigma}X_{\rho\sigma}$, $\tilde H = i\sigma^2 H^*$.
\\[6pt]
\textbf{IR matching conditions (``Known Physics''):}
\begin{itemize}
\item $\langle H\rangle = v/\sqrt{2}$ with $v \simeq 246\ \text{GeV}$; reproduce $m_W = \tfrac12 g_2 v$, $m_Z = \tfrac12 \sqrt{g_1^2+g_2^2}\, v$, photon massless.
\item Choose $Y_{u,d,e,\nu}$ to match observed fermion masses and mixings (CKM, PMNS); $M_R$ large gives see-saw if desired.
\item Set $\zeta_F/M_F^2,\ \varepsilon_a/M_\psi \to 0$ at/near the weak scale; keep $c_1{+}c_3\!=\!0$ and $|c_{2,4}|\!\ll\!1$ so Lorentz tests are satisfied.
\item Either (A) decouple $\theta_4$ from QCD/electroweak ($\kappa_i\!\to\!0$) to make it a spectator, or (B) identify $\theta_4$ as an axion-like field: choose $\kappa_3\neq0$ to address strong CP and ensure domain-wall number $N_{\rm DW}=3$ issues are controlled (e.g.\ by biasing or inflationary history).
\end{itemize}
\textbf{Notes:} Gauge group and chiral content exactly match the SM; foliation operators are irrelevant in the IR if their coefficients satisfy experimental bounds; higher-spatial-derivative terms regulate the UV but do not affect IR observables.
\end{document}
"""
with open("/mnt/data/SM_embedding_minimal.tex", "w") as f:
    f.write(latex)
print("Saved to /mnt/data/SM_embedding_minimal.tex")

Awesome—yes, we can make this machinery reproduce (and then gently extend) the known Standard Model. Here’s a clear, step-by-step route, with a ready-to-use LaTeX snippet you can drop into notes or a paper.

# Roadmap to “known physics”

1. **Dial the IR to look Lorentz-invariant.**  
   Keep the foliation sector but suppress visible LIV in the infrared:
   - Enforce \(u^2=-1\) via \(\lambda\).  
   - Impose \(c_1 + c_3 \simeq 0\) and take \(|c_2|,|c_4|\) tiny; push gauge/fermion LV spurions \(\zeta_F/M_F^2,\ \varepsilon_a/M_\psi\) \(\to 0\) near the weak scale.  
   These are exactly the “Core + small Soft” settings in your manual, consistent with gravitational-wave/SME bounds filecite8:Minimal Lagrangian.txtL1-L21 filecite9:operators_manual.txtL36-L64.

2. **Choose the SM gauge group and chiral content.**  
   Set \(G_{\rm SM}=SU(3)_c\times SU(2)_L\times U(1)_Y\). Keep the usual chiral fermions and covariant derivatives, add the Higgs doublet \(H\). This fits directly into your \(\mathcal L_{\text{gauge}}\) and \(\mathcal L_{\text{ferm}}\) slots (we’re just specializing “\(I\)” to the SM factors and making the fermions chiral) filecite10:Master Lagrangian .txtL1-L26.

3. **Add the Higgs sector and Yukawas (the only real “new” block).**  
   Insert the standard \(\mathcal L_H=(D_\mu H)^\dagger(D^\mu H)-\lambda_H(H^\dagger H-\tfrac{v^2}{2})^2\) and \(\mathcal L_Y\) for SM masses/mixings. This reproduces \(m_W,m_Z\) and fermion masses once \(v\simeq246\) GeV is chosen.

4. **Decide what \(\theta_4\) does in the SM limit.** Two clean options:  
   - **Spectator:** set \(\kappa_i\!\to\!0\) so \(\theta_4\) barely talks to the SM; it just lives in a hidden sector with its \(2\pi/3\) periodicity and tiny mixings.  
   - **Axion-like:** keep \(\kappa_3\neq0\) for \(\theta_4\, G\tilde G\) to address strong-CP (then manage domain-wall number \(N_{\rm DW}=3\) with explicit bias or cosmology). Both uses are anticipated by your topological term \(\theta_4 F\tilde F\) filecite8:Minimal Lagrangian.txtL1-L21 filecite9:operators_manual.txtL19-L35.

5. **Match to observables.**  
   - Electroweak: \(m_W=\tfrac12 g_2 v,\ m_Z=\tfrac12\sqrt{g_1^2+g_2^2}\,v\); photon stays massless.  
   - Flavor: pick \(Y_{u,d,e,\nu}\) for SM masses/CKM/PMNS; optional seesaw via \(M_R\).  
   - LV checks: with \(c_1{+}c_3\!=\!0\) and small \(c_{2,4},\zeta_F,\varepsilon_a\), you fall inside the manual’s constraint anchors (GW170817, SME, EDMs) filecite9:operators_manual.txtL36-L64.

# A concrete embedding you can use

I’ve generated a compact LaTeX block that plugs the full SM (gauge + chiral fermions + Higgs + Yukawas) into your framework, while keeping the foliation and \(\theta_4\) sectors exactly as you defined them. It includes the “IR matching conditions” checklist.

[Download the LaTeX snippet](sandbox:/mnt/data/SM_embedding_minimal.tex)

# What this buys you right now

- **Exact reproduction of SM scattering and spectra** at accessible energies once you pick the usual SM parameters; the foliation/LV and higher-spatial-derivative terms are negligible in the IR (but ready for UV control) filecite9:operators_manual.txtL1-L18.
- **A controlled extension point**: turn on \(\kappa_i\) (especially \(\kappa_3\)) for axion phenomenology; gently raise \(\zeta_F,\varepsilon_a\) or \(\tilde c_3/M_u^2\) for testable LIV/dispersion effects without spoiling known physics.

If you want, I can also spin up a tiny parameter-scan table next that (i) fixes the SM sector at its PDG values, (ii) varies \((c_2,c_4,\zeta_F/M_F^2,\varepsilon_a/M_\psi)\) within the “manual” bounds, and (iii) flags any conflicts with EDM/SME anchors—so you’ll see precisely how much room is left for new effects.

import pandas as pd
from caas_jupyter_tools import display_dataframe_to_user

# Load the user's constraint table
path = "/mnt/data/Constraint_table__initial__with_bounds_anchors_.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(path)

# Give a quick peek (first 20 rows) to the user
sample = df.head(20).copy()

# Try to normalize a few likely column names for convenience in later steps
# (We'll just detect common patterns; if not present, we keep as-is.)
cols = {c.lower(): c for c in df.columns}
canonical = {
    "operator": cols.get("operator", None),
    "sector": cols.get("sector", None),
    "baseline": cols.get("baseline", None),
    "lower_bound": cols.get("lower_bound", cols.get("min", None)),
    "upper_bound": cols.get("upper_bound", cols.get("max", None)),
    "anchor": cols.get("anchor", cols.get("experimental_anchor", None)),
    "notes": cols.get("notes", None),
}
# Attach a normalized view if possible
norm_cols = [c for c in canonical.values() if c is not None]
norm_view = df[norm_cols].head(50).copy() if norm_cols else sample

display_dataframe_to_user("Constraint table (peek)", norm_view)

print("Rows:", len(df))
print("Columns:", list(df.columns))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from caas_jupyter_tools import display_dataframe_to_user

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

# ------------------------------
# 1) Define illustrative "anchor" thresholds (order-of-magnitude from the manual)
#    These are intentionally conservative and can be tightened/relaxed later.
# ------------------------------
bounds = {
    "abs_c1_plus_c3": 1e-15,   # GW170817-like
    "abs_c2": 1e-7,            # Solar-system/pulsar wedge (order of magnitude)
    "abs_c4": 1e-7,            # same ballpark
    "zetaF_over_MF2": 1e-20,   # proxy for SME photon LIV -> extremely small
    "eps_over_Mpsi": 1e-20,    # SME fermion LIV (atomic clocks/comagnetometers)
    # Axion-like sector placeholders (these depend on mass/coupling model details)
    "g_agammagamma": 1e-11,    # CAST/PDG-ish scale (GeV^-1) for light ALPs
    "de_elec": 1.1e-29,        # e EDM (e*cm)
    "dn_neut": 1.8e-26,        # n EDM (e*cm)
}

# ------------------------------
# 2) Build a random seed grid around the "Baseline Settings" from the manual
# ------------------------------
N = 500
data = pd.DataFrame({
    "c1_plus_c3": rng.normal(loc=0.0, scale=1e-16, size=N),            # centered at 0
    "c2": rng.uniform(-5e-8, 5e-8, size=N),                            # within wedge
    "c4": rng.uniform(-5e-8, 5e-8, size=N),
    "zetaF_over_MF2": rng.lognormal(mean=np.log(1e-22), sigma=0.5, size=N),  # mostly below 1e-20
    "eps_over_Mpsi": rng.lognormal(mean=np.log(1e-22), sigma=0.5, size=N),
    # Axion-like knobs: treat as independent to start
    "g_agammagamma": rng.lognormal(mean=np.log(1e-12), sigma=0.6, size=N),
    # Extremely naive proxy EDM contributions: scale with small couplings
    # (In a full model these come from loops with CPV; we use placeholders here.)
    "de_pred": rng.lognormal(mean=np.log(1e-30), sigma=0.6, size=N),
    "dn_pred": rng.lognormal(mean=np.log(1e-27), sigma=0.6, size=N),
    # Tag whether theta4 is "spectator" (kappa_i ~ 0) or "axion-like"
    "theta4_mode": rng.choice(["spectator", "axion-like"], size=N, p=[0.5, 0.5]),
})

# ------------------------------
# 3) Evaluate pass/fail gates
# ------------------------------
def passes(row):
    checks = {}
    checks["GW_speed"] = abs(row["c1_plus_c3"]) <= bounds["abs_c1_plus_c3"]
    checks["foliation_wedge"] = (abs(row["c2"]) <= bounds["abs_c2"]) and (abs(row["c4"]) <= bounds["abs_c4"])
    checks["photon_LIV"] = row["zetaF_over_MF2"] <= bounds["zetaF_over_MF2"]
    checks["fermion_LIV"] = row["eps_over_Mpsi"] <= bounds["eps_over_Mpsi"]
    if row["theta4_mode"] == "spectator":
        checks["axion_coupling"] = True
    else:
        checks["axion_coupling"] = row["g_agammagamma"] <= bounds["g_agammagamma"]
    checks["EDM_electron"] = row["de_pred"] <= bounds["de_elec"]
    checks["EDM_neutron"] = row["dn_pred"] <= bounds["dn_neut"]
    # Aggregate
    passed = all(checks.values())
    return pd.Series({"passed": passed, **checks})

evals = data.apply(passes, axis=1)
scan = pd.concat([data, evals], axis=1)

# ------------------------------
# 4) Summaries
# ------------------------------
survivors = scan[scan["passed"]].copy()
survivor_rate = len(survivors) / N if N else 0.0

# Identify most constraining gates (fewest pass rate among individual checks)
gate_pass_rates = evals.drop(columns=["passed"]).mean().sort_values()

# ------------------------------
# 5) Present to user & save artifacts
# ------------------------------
top20 = survivors.head(20).copy()
display_dataframe_to_user("Viable parameter points (first 20)", top20)

summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "metric": ["survivors", "total", "survivor_rate"],
    "value": [len(survivors), N, survivor_rate],
})

gate_table = pd.DataFrame({"gate": gate_pass_rates.index, "pass_rate": gate_pass_rates.values})
display_dataframe_to_user("Gate pass rates (higher is easier)", gate_table)

survivors_path = "/mnt/data/scan_viable_points.csv"
scan_path = "/mnt/data/scan_full_results.csv"
gate_path = "/mnt/data/scan_gate_pass_rates.csv"

survivors.to_csv(survivors_path, index=False)
scan.to_csv(scan_path, index=False)
gate_table.to_csv(gate_path, index=False)

print("Saved:")
print(survivors_path)
print(scan_path)
print(gate_path)
print("Survivor rate:", survivor_rate)

first_fail_counts = scan["first_fail"].value_counts().rename_axis("gate").reset_index(name="count")
first_fail_counts["fraction"] = first_fail_counts["count"] / N

# Save artifacts
paths = {

    "zetaF_over_MF2": 1e-22,
    "eps_over_Mpsi": 1e-22,
    "g_agammagamma": 5e-12,
    "de_elec": 1.1e-29,
    "dn_neut": 1.8e-26,
}

# Helper: compute margins to bounds (how close each parameter is to its gate)
def margin_to_bound(row):
    return pd.Series({
        "marg_GW": bounds["abs_c1_plus_c3"] / max(1e-40, abs(row["c1_plus_c3"])),
        "marg_c2": bounds["abs_c2"] / max(1e-40, abs(row["c2"])),
        "marg_c4": bounds["abs_c4"] / max(1e-40, abs(row["c4"])),
        "marg_photon": bounds["zetaF_over_MF2"] / max(1e-300, row["zetaF_over_MF2"]),
        "marg_fermion": bounds["eps_over_Mpsi"] / max(1e-300, row["eps_over_Mpsi"]),
        "marg_axion": (np.inf if row["theta4_mode"]=="spectator" else bounds["g_agammagamma"] / max(1e-300, row["g_agammagamma"])),
        "marg_de": bounds["de_elec"] / max(1e-300, row["de_pred"]),
        "marg_dn": bounds["dn_neut"] / max(1e-300, row["dn_pred"]),
    })

margins = survivors.apply(margin_to_bound, axis=1)
survivors_m = pd.concat([survivors, margins], axis=1)

# Selection strategy:
# 1) Spectator point with tight foliation wedge (smallest max(|c2|,|c4|))
spec = survivors_m[survivors_m["theta4_mode"]=="spectator"].copy()
spec = spec.assign(wedge=np.maximum(np.abs(spec["c2"]), np.abs(spec["c4"])))
bm1 = spec.sort_values("wedge").head(1)

# 2) Axion-like point closest to axion coupling gate (marg_axion minimal but >1)
axi = survivors_m[survivors_m["theta4_mode"]=="axion-like"].copy()
axi = axi[axi["marg_axion"]>1.0]
bm2 = axi.sort_values("marg_axion").head(1)

# 3) Point that is "most stressed" overall: smallest minimum margin among all gates
marg_cols = ["marg_GW","marg_c2","marg_c4","marg_photon","marg_fermion","marg_axion","marg_de","marg_dn"]
survivors_m["min_margin"] = survivors_m[marg_cols].replace(np.inf, 1e30).min(axis=1)
bm3 = survivors_m.sort_values("min_margin").head(1)

benchmarks = pd.concat([bm1, bm2, bm3]).drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

# Create a compact display table
def fmt(x):
    if np.isinf(x):
        return "inf"
    return f"{x:.3g}"

cols_show = [
    "theta4_mode",
    "c1_plus_c3","c2","c4",
    "zetaF_over_MF2","eps_over_Mpsi",
    "g_agammagamma","de_pred","dn_pred",
    "marg_GW","marg_c2","marg_c4","marg_photon","marg_fermion","marg_axion","marg_de","marg_dn",
    "min_margin"
]
bench_disp = benchmarks[cols_show].copy()
for c in bench_disp.columns:
    bench_disp[c] = bench_disp[c].apply(fmt) if bench_disp[c].dtype != object else bench_disp[c]

display_dataframe_to_user("Three benchmark survivors (values and safety margins)", bench_disp)

# Save a CSV with the raw numbers
benchmarks.to_csv("/mnt/data/benchmarks_three_raw.csv", index=False)
print("Saved /mnt/data/benchmarks_three_raw.csv")

   The smallest **minimum margin** across all gates (GW speed, wedge, SME spurions, axion, EDMs). This is the point most likely to get excluded if any bound tightens.

- Each **margin** is (bound ÷ value).  
  - e.g., **marg\_GW** \(=\frac{10^{-17}}{|c_1{+}c_3|}\). A margin \(\sim1\) means “right at the limit”; \(>10\) means “one order of magnitude safe.”

if not margin_cols:

        "abs_c1_plus_c3": 1e-17,

        "abs_c4": 1e-8,
        "zetaF_over_MF2": 1e-22,
        "eps_over_Mpsi": 1e-22,
        "g_agammagamma": 5e-12,
        "de_elec": 1.1e-29,
        "dn_neut": 1.8e-26,
    }
    def margin_to_bound(row):
        return pd.Series({
            "marg_GW": bounds["abs_c1_plus_c3"] / max(1e-40, abs(row["c1_plus_c3"])),
            "marg_c2": bounds["abs_c2"] / max(1e-40, abs(row["c2"])),
            "marg_c4": bounds["abs_c4"] / max(1e-40, abs(row["c4"])),
            "marg_photon": bounds["zetaF_over_MF2"] / max(1e-300, row["zetaF_over_MF2"]),

            "marg_axion": (np.inf if row["theta4_mode"]=="spectator" else bounds["g_agammagamma"] / max(1e-300, row["g_agammagamma"])),
            "marg_de": bounds["de_elec"] / max(1e-300, row["de_pred"]),
            "marg_dn": bounds["dn_neut"] / max(1e-300, row["dn_pred"]),
        })
    margins = bench.apply(margin_to_bound, axis=1)
    bench = pd.concat([bench, margins], axis=1)

# Helper to make per-benchmark plots
def plot_margins(row, idx_label):
    margins = {
        "GW_speed": row["marg_GW"],
        "c2": row["marg_c2"],
        "c4": row["marg_c4"],
        "photon_LIV": row["marg_photon"],
        "fermion_LIV": row["marg_fermion"],
        "axion_coupling": (np.inf if row["theta4_mode"]=="spectator" else row["marg_axion"]),
        "EDM_e": row["marg_de"],
        "EDM_n": row["marg_dn"],
    }
    # Replace inf with a cap for plotting
    cap = 1e4
    vals = [min(v, cap) if np.isfinite(v) else cap for v in margins.values()]
    labels = list(margins.keys())
    plt.figure()
    plt.bar(labels, vals)
    plt.yscale("log")
    plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha="right")
    plt.title(f"Safety margins (>{1} passes) — {idx_label}")
    plt.tight_layout()
    outpath = f"/mnt/data/bm_{idx_label}_margins.png"

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from textwrap import dedent

# Load the three benchmarks with margins included
bench = pd.read_csv("/mnt/data/benchmarks_three_raw.csv")

# Ensure expected margin columns exist
margin_cols = [c for c in bench.columns if c.startswith("marg_")]
if not margin_cols:
    # If margins are not present, compute them (fallback)
    bounds = {
        "abs_c1_plus_c3": 1e-17,
        "abs_c2": 1e-8,
        "abs_c4": 1e-8,
        "zetaF_over_MF2": 1e-22,
        "eps_over_Mpsi": 1e-22,
        "g_agammagamma": 5e-12,
        "de_elec": 1.1e-29,
        "dn_neut": 1.8e-26,
    }
    def margin_to_bound(row):
        return pd.Series({
            "marg_GW": bounds["abs_c1_plus_c3"] / max(1e-40, abs(row["c1_plus_c3"])),
            "marg_c2": bounds["abs_c2"] / max(1e-40, abs(row["c2"])),
            "marg_c4": bounds["abs_c4"] / max(1e-40, abs(row["c4"])),
            "marg_photon": bounds["zetaF_over_MF2"] / max(1e-300, row["zetaF_over_MF2"]),
            "marg_fermion": bounds["eps_over_Mpsi"] / max(1e-300, row["eps_over_Mpsi"]),
            "marg_axion": (np.inf if row["theta4_mode"]=="spectator" else bounds["g_agammagamma"] / max(1e-300, row["g_agammagamma"])),
            "marg_de": bounds["de_elec"] / max(1e-300, row["de_pred"]),
            "marg_dn": bounds["dn_neut"] / max(1e-300, row["dn_pred"]),
        })
    margins = bench.apply(margin_to_bound, axis=1)
    bench = pd.concat([bench, margins], axis=1)

# Helper to make per-benchmark plots
def plot_margins(row, idx_label):
    margins = {
        "GW_speed": row["marg_GW"],
        "c2": row["marg_c2"],
        "c4": row["marg_c4"],
        "photon_LIV": row["marg_photon"],
        "fermion_LIV": row["marg_fermion"],
        "axion_coupling": (np.inf if row["theta4_mode"]=="spectator" else row["marg_axion"]),
        "EDM_e": row["marg_de"],
        "EDM_n": row["marg_dn"],
    }
    # Replace inf with a cap for plotting
    cap = 1e4
    vals = [min(v, cap) if np.isfinite(v) else cap for v in margins.values()]
    labels = list(margins.keys())
    plt.figure()
    plt.bar(labels, vals)
    plt.yscale("log")
    plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha="right")
    plt.title(f"Safety margins (>{1} passes) — {idx_label}")
    plt.tight_layout()
    outpath = f"/mnt/data/bm_{idx_label}_margins.png"
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    return outpath

# Build markdown dossier
md_lines = []
md_lines.append("# Benchmark Dossier (Frontier Survivors)\n")
md_lines.append("These three points are representative: (1) spectator with ultra-tight foliation wedge, (2) axion-like near the coupling frontier, (3) most stressed overall (smallest minimum margin).")
md_lines.append("\n**Note:** margins are (bound ÷ value). Values ≥ 1 pass the gate; ~1 sits right at the limit.\n")

plots = []
for i, row in bench.iterrows():
    idx = i+1
    label = f"BM-{idx} ({row['theta4_mode']})"
    # plot margins
    p = plot_margins(row, f"BM{idx}")
    plots.append(p)
    # ratios to bounds (how close): r = 1/margin
    ratios = {
        "GW_speed": 1/row["marg_GW"],
        "c2": 1/row["marg_c2"],
        "c4": 1/row["marg_c4"],
        "photon_LIV": 1/row["marg_photon"],
        "fermion_LIV": 1/row["marg_fermion"],
        "axion_coupling": (0.0 if row["theta4_mode"]=="spectator" else 1/row["marg_axion"]),
        "EDM_e": 1/row["marg_de"],
        "EDM_n": 1/row["marg_dn"],
    }
    md_lines.append(f"## {label}")
    md_lines.append(f"- **c1+c3:** {row['c1_plus_c3']:.3e}  |  **c2:** {row['c2']:.3e}  |  **c4:** {row['c4']:.3e}")
    md_lines.append(f"- **zetaF/MF^2:** {row['zetaF_over_MF2']:.3e}  |  **eps/Mpsi:** {row['eps_over_Mpsi']:.3e}")
    if row["theta4_mode"]=="axion-like":
        md_lines.append(f"- **g_agammagamma:** {row['g_agammagamma']:.3e} GeV^-1")
    else:
        md_lines.append(f"- **theta4:** spectator (no axion-coupling gate)")
    md_lines.append(f"- **EDM proxies:** d_e={row['de_pred']:.3e} e·cm, d_n={row['dn_pred']:.3e} e·cm")
    md_lines.append(f"- **Min safety margin:** {row['min_margin']:.3g}")
    md_lines.append(f"- **Safety margins:** GW={row['marg_GW']:.2g}, c2={row['marg_c2']:.2g}, c4={row['marg_c4']:.2g}, photon={row['marg_photon']:.2g}, fermion={row['marg_fermion']:.2g}, axion={'∞' if row['theta4_mode']=='spectator' else f'{row['marg_axion']:.2g}'}, EDM_e={row['marg_de']:.2g}, EDM_n={row['marg_dn']:.2g}")

    md_lines.append(f"![Margins]({p})\n")

# Save markdown dossier
report_path = "/mnt/data/benchmark_dossier.md"

\\[6pt]
\textbf{Lagrangian:}
\begin{align}
\mathcal{L} &\;=\; \mathcal{L}_{\text{fol}} + \mathcal{L}_{\theta} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{gauge}}^{\rm SM} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{ferm}}^{\rm SM} + \mathcal{L}_{H} + \mathcal{L}_{Y} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{top}}^{\rm SM}\,.
\\[4pt]
\mathcal{L}_{\text{fol}} &\;=\; \lambda\!\left((\partial T)^2+1\right)
+ c_1(\partial_\mu u_\nu)(\partial^\mu u^\nu)
+ c_2(\partial_\mu u^\mu)^2
+ \frac{\tilde c_3}{M_u^2}\!\left(\Delta^{\alpha\beta}\partial_\alpha\partial_\beta u_\mu\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\theta} &\;=\; \frac{Z_\perp}{2}\Delta^{\mu\nu}\partial_\mu\theta_4\partial_\nu\theta_4
- \frac{Z_\parallel}{2}(u^\mu\partial_\mu\theta_4)^2
- \mu^2\cos(3\theta_4)
+ \frac{1}{2M_\theta^2}\!\left(\Delta^{\mu\nu}\partial_\mu\partial_\nu\theta_4\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{gauge}}^{\rm SM} &\;=\; -\frac14 G^A_{\mu\nu}G^{A\mu\nu}
- \frac14 W^I_{\mu\nu}W^{I\mu\nu}
- \frac14 B_{\mu\nu}B^{\mu\nu},
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{ferm}}^{\rm SM} &\;=\; \sum_{\text{gen}}\Big[\,
\bar q_L i\slashed{D} q_L + \bar u_R i\slashed{D} u_R + \bar d_R i\slashed{D} d_R
+ \bar\ell_L i\slashed{D} \ell_L + \bar e_R i\slashed{D} e_R
+ \bar\nu_R i\slashed{D}\nu_R \Big] ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_H &\;=\; (D_\mu H)^\dagger(D^\mu H) - \lambda_H\!\left(H^\dagger H - \tfrac{v^2}{2}\right)^2 ,
\\

\section*{SM embedding in foliation + axion framework (flat spacetime)}
\noindent
IR limit assumes approximate Lorentz invariance: $c_1 + c_3 \!=\! 0$, $|c_2|,|c_4|\!\ll\!1$; set $\zeta_F/M_F^2,\ \varepsilon_a/M_\psi \to 0$.
\\[4pt]
\textbf{Field content:} Standard Model gauge group $G_{\rm SM}=SU(3)_c\times SU(2)_L\times U(1)_Y$, chiral fermions $q_L,u_R,d_R,\ell_L,e_R$ (and $\nu_R$ optional), Higgs doublet $H$ (hypercharge $+1/2$), plus foliation clock $T$ and periodic scalar $\theta_4$ (period $2\pi/3$).
\\[6pt]
\textbf{Lagrangian:}
\begin{align}
\mathcal{L} &\;=\; \mathcal{L}_{\text{fol}} + \mathcal{L}_{\theta} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{gauge}}^{\rm SM} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{ferm}}^{\rm SM} + \mathcal{L}_{H} + \mathcal{L}_{Y} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{top}}^{\rm SM}\,.
\\[4pt]
\mathcal{L}_{\text{fol}} &\;=\; \lambda\!\left((\partial T)^2+1\right)
+ c_1(\partial_\mu u_\nu)(\partial^\mu u^\nu)
+ c_2(\partial_\mu u^\mu)^2
+ \frac{\tilde c_3}{M_u^2}\!\left(\Delta^{\alpha\beta}\partial_\alpha\partial_\beta u_\mu\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\theta} &\;=\; \frac{Z_\perp}{2}\Delta^{\mu\nu}\partial_\mu\theta_4\partial_\nu\theta_4
- \frac{Z_\parallel}{2}(u^\mu\partial_\mu\theta_4)^2
- \mu^2\cos(3\theta_4)
+ \frac{1}{2M_\theta^2}\!\left(\Delta^{\mu\nu}\partial_\mu\partial_\nu\theta_4\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{gauge}}^{\rm SM} &\;=\; -\frac14 G^A_{\mu\nu}G^{A\mu\nu}
- \frac14 W^I_{\mu\nu}W^{I\mu\nu}
- \frac14 B_{\mu\nu}B^{\mu\nu},
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{ferm}}^{\rm SM} &\;=\; \sum_{\text{gen}}\Big[\,
\bar q_L i\slashed{D} q_L + \bar u_R i\slashed{D} u_R + \bar d_R i\slashed{D} d_R
+ \bar\ell_L i\slashed{D} \ell_L + \bar e_R i\slashed{D} e_R
+ \bar\nu_R i\slashed{D}\nu_R \Big] ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_H &\;=\; (D_\mu H)^\dagger(D^\mu H) - \lambda_H\!\left(H^\dagger H - \tfrac{v^2}{2}\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_Y &\;=\; - \bar q_L Y_u \tilde H u_R - \bar q_L Y_d H d_R - \bar \ell_L Y_e H e_R
- \tfrac12\, \bar \nu_R^c M_R \nu_R - \bar \ell_L Y_\nu \tilde H \nu_R + \text{h.c.}\,,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{top}}^{\rm SM} &\;=\; \frac{\kappa_3}{32\pi^2}\,\theta_4\, G^A_{\mu\nu}\tilde G^{A\mu\nu}
+ \frac{\kappa_2}{32\pi^2}\,\theta_4\, W^I_{\mu\nu}\tilde W^{I\mu\nu}
+ \frac{\kappa_1}{32\pi^2}\,\theta_4\, B_{\mu\nu}\tilde B^{\mu\nu}\,.
\end{align}
\textbf{Definitions:} $u_\mu = -\partial_\mu T / \sqrt{-(\partial T)^2}$, $\Delta^{\mu\nu}=\eta^{\mu\nu}+u^\mu u^\nu$, $\tilde X^{\mu\nu}=\tfrac12\epsilon^{\mu\nu\rho\sigma}X_{\rho\sigma}$, $\tilde H = i\sigma^2 H^*$.
\\[6pt]
\textbf{IR matching conditions (``Known Physics''):}
\begin{itemize}
\item $\langle H\rangle = v/\sqrt{2}$ with $v \simeq 246\ \text{GeV}$; reproduce $m_W = \tfrac12 g_2 v$, $m_Z = \tfrac12 \sqrt{g_1^2+g_2^2}\, v$, photon massless.
\item Choose $Y_{u,d,e,\nu}$ to match observed fermion masses and mixings (CKM, PMNS); $M_R$ large gives see-saw if desired.
\item Set $\zeta_F/M_F^2,\ \varepsilon_a/M_\psi \to 0$ at/near the weak scale; keep $c_1{+}c_3\!=\!0$ and $|c_{2,4}|\!\ll\!1$ so Lorentz tests are satisfied.
\item Either (A) decouple $\theta_4$ from QCD/electroweak ($\kappa_i\!\to\!0$) to make it a spectator, or (B) identify $\theta_4$ as an axion-like field: choose $\kappa_3\neq0$ to address strong CP and ensure domain-wall number $N_{\rm DW}=3$ issues are controlled (e.g.\ by biasing or inflationary history).
\end{itemize}
\textbf{Notes:} Gauge group and chiral content exactly match the SM; foliation operators are irrelevant in the IR if their coefficients satisfy experimental bounds; higher-spatial-derivative terms regulate the UV but do not affect IR observables.
\end{document}

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load benchmark rows
bench = pd.read_csv("/mnt/data/benchmarks_three_raw.csv")

# Bounds used
bounds = {
    "abs_c1_plus_c3": 1e-17,
    "abs_c2": 1e-8,
    "abs_c4": 1e-8,
    "zetaF_over_MF2": 1e-22,
    "eps_over_Mpsi": 1e-22,
    "g_agammagamma": 5e-12,
    "de_elec": 1.1e-29,
    "dn_neut": 1.8e-26,
}

# Build an "observable pack" of normalized figures of merit (FOM): value / bound
packs = []
for i, row in bench.iterrows():
    fom = {
        "BM": f"BM-{i+1} ({row['theta4_mode']})",
        "FOM_GW": abs(row["c1_plus_c3"]) / bounds["abs_c1_plus_c3"],
        "FOM_c2": abs(row["c2"]) / bounds["abs_c2"],
        "FOM_c4": abs(row["c4"]) / bounds["abs_c4"],
        "FOM_photon": row["zetaF_over_MF2"] / bounds["zetaF_over_MF2"],
        "FOM_fermion": row["eps_over_Mpsi"] / bounds["eps_over_Mpsi"],
        "FOM_axion": (0.0 if row["theta4_mode"]=="spectator" else row["g_agammagamma"] / bounds["g_agammagamma"]),
        "FOM_d_e": row["de_pred"] / bounds["de_elec"],
        "FOM_d_n": row["dn_pred"] / bounds["dn_neut"],
    }
    packs.append(fom)

pack_df = pd.DataFrame(packs)
pack_df.to_csv("/mnt/data/benchmark_observable_pack.csv", index=False)

# Make per-BM bar charts of FOMs (values < 1 pass, ~1 at bound, >1 would fail)
for i, row in pack_df.iterrows():
    labels = ["GW","c2","c4","photon","fermion","axion","EDM_e","EDM_n"]
    values = [row["FOM_GW"], row["FOM_c2"], row["FOM_c4"], row["FOM_photon"],
              row["FOM_fermion"], row["FOM_axion"], row["FOM_d_e"], row["FOM_d_n"]]
    # Replace zeros (spectator axion) with a tiny number for log plotting aesthetics
    plot_vals = [v if v>0 else 1e-6 for v in values]
    plt.figure()
    plt.bar(labels, plot_vals)
    plt.yscale("log")
    plt.axhline(1.0)  # bound line
    plt.title(f"Normalized FOMs (value / bound) — {row['BM']}")
    plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha="right")
    plt.tight_layout()
    out = f"/mnt/data/{row['BM'].split()[0].lower()}_foms.png".replace("(", "").replace(")", "").replace("/", "_")
    plt.savefig(out)
    plt.close()

print("Created: /mnt/data/benchmark_observable_pack.csv")
print("And per-BM FOM plots saved alongside.")

import pandas as pd

from caas_jupyter_tools import display_dataframe_to_user

# Load the base frontier scan (8k points with raw parameters)
base = pd.read_csv("/mnt/data/frontier_full_results.csv")

# Define base bounds from the stress frontier run
base_bounds = {
    "abs_c1_plus_c3": 1e-17,
    "abs_c2": 1e-8,
    "abs_c4": 1e-8,
    "zetaF_over_MF2": 1e-22,
    "eps_over_Mpsi": 1e-22,
    "g_agammagamma": 5e-12,
    "de_elec": 1.1e-29,
    "dn_neut": 1.8e-26,
}

def eval_with_bounds(df, bounds):
    """Return survivor mask, gate pass rates, and first-fail breakdown under given bounds."""
    def row_eval(row):
        checks = {}
        checks["GW_speed"] = abs(row["c1_plus_c3"]) <= bounds["abs_c1_plus_c3"]
        checks["foliation_wedge"] = (abs(row["c2"]) <= bounds["abs_c2"]) and (abs(row["c4"]) <= bounds["abs_c4"])
        checks["photon_LIV"] = row["zetaF_over_MF2"] <= bounds["zetaF_over_MF2"]
        checks["fermion_LIV"] = row["eps_over_Mpsi"] <= bounds["eps_over_Mpsi"]
        if row["theta4_mode"] == "spectator":
            checks["axion_coupling"] = True
        else:
            checks["axion_coupling"] = row["g_agammagamma"] <= bounds["g_agammagamma"]
        checks["EDM_electron"] = row["de_pred"] <= bounds["de_elec"]
        checks["EDM_neutron"] = row["dn_pred"] <= bounds["dn_neut"]
        passed = all(checks.values())
        first_fail = ""
        if not passed:
            for k,v in checks.items():
                if not v:
                    first_fail = k
                    break
        return pd.Series({"passed_new": passed, "first_fail_new": first_fail, **checks})
    ev = df.apply(row_eval, axis=1)
    survivors = ev["passed_new"].sum()
    N = len(df)
    pass_rates = ev.drop(columns=["passed_new","first_fail_new"]).mean().rename("pass_rate")
    first_fail_counts = ev["first_fail_new"].value_counts().rename_axis("gate").rename("count").reset_index()
    first_fail_counts["fraction"] = first_fail_counts["count"]/N
    return ev["passed_new"].values, pass_rates, first_fail_counts

# Sensitivity factors (tighten/loosen each gate independently)
factors = [0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0]

results = []
elasticity = []

for gate in ["abs_c1_plus_c3","abs_c2","abs_c4","zetaF_over_MF2","eps_over_Mpsi","g_agammagamma","de_elec","dn_neut"]:
    for f in factors:
        b = base_bounds.copy()
        b[gate] = base_bounds[gate] * f
        passed_mask, pass_rates, first_fail = eval_with_bounds(base, b)

            "gate_varied": gate,

sens_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

display_dataframe_to_user("Elasticity ranking (which gate most changes viability near current bounds)", elas_df)

elas_df.to_csv("/mnt/data/sensitivity_elasticity_at1.csv", index=False)

print("Saved: /mnt/data/sensitivity_elasticity_at1.csv")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from caas_jupyter_tools import display_dataframe_to_user

# Retry with vectorized evaluation (no per-row apply)
base = pd.read_csv("/mnt/data/frontier_full_results.csv")

base_bounds = {
    "abs_c1_plus_c3": 1e-17,
    "abs_c2": 1e-8,
    "abs_c4": 1e-8,
    "zetaF_over_MF2": 1e-22,
    "eps_over_Mpsi": 1e-22,
    "g_agammagamma": 5e-12,
    "de_elec": 1.1e-29,
    "dn_neut": 1.8e-26,
}

def survivors_rate_under_bounds(df, b):
    GW = (df["c1_plus_c3"].abs() <= b["abs_c1_plus_c3"])
    wedge = (df["c2"].abs() <= b["abs_c2"]) & (df["c4"].abs() <= b["abs_c4"])
    photon = (df["zetaF_over_MF2"] <= b["zetaF_over_MF2"])
    fermion = (df["eps_over_Mpsi"] <= b["eps_over_Mpsi"])
    axion_gate = (df["theta4_mode"] == "spectator") | (df["g_agammagamma"] <= b["g_agammagamma"])
    edm_e = (df["de_pred"] <= b["de_elec"])
    edm_n = (df["dn_pred"] <= b["dn_neut"])
    passed = GW & wedge & photon & fermion & axion_gate & edm_e & edm_n
    return passed.mean()

factors = [0.1, 0.3, 1.0, 3.0, 10.0]
gates = ["abs_c1_plus_c3","abs_c2","abs_c4","zetaF_over_MF2","eps_over_Mpsi","g_agammagamma","de_elec","dn_neut"]

records = []
for gate in gates:
    for f in factors:
        b = base_bounds.copy()
        b[gate] = base_bounds[gate] * f
        rate = survivors_rate_under_bounds(base, b)
        records.append({"gate_varied": gate, "factor": f, "survivor_rate": rate})

sens_df = pd.DataFrame(records)

# Elasticity estimate using neighbors around f=1 (log slope)
elas = []
for gate in gates:
    row = sens_df[sens_df["gate_varied"]==gate].set_index("factor")["survivor_rate"]
    if set([0.3,1.0,3.0]).issubset(row.index):
        slope = (row.loc[3.0]-row.loc[0.3])/(np.log10(3.0)-np.log10(0.3))
        elas.append({"gate": gate, "elasticity_at_1": slope})
elas_df = pd.DataFrame(elas).sort_values("elasticity_at_1", ascending=False)

# Present
pivot = sens_df.pivot_table(index="factor", columns="gate_varied", values="survivor_rate").reset_index()
display_dataframe_to_user("Sensitivity sweep (vectorized): survivor rate vs factor", pivot)
display_dataframe_to_user("Elasticity ranking at current bounds", elas_df)

# Save
sens_df.to_csv("/mnt/data/sensitivity_survivors_by_gate_vec.csv", index=False)
elas_df.to_csv("/mnt/data/sensitivity_elasticity_at1_vec.csv", index=False)

print("Saved: /mnt/data/sensitivity_survivors_by_gate_vec.csv")
print("Saved: /mnt/data/sensitivity_elasticity_at1_vec.csv")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from caas_jupyter_tools import display_dataframe_to_user

# ---------- Load data ----------
survivors = pd.read_csv("/mnt/data/frontier_viable_points.csv")
bench = pd.read_csv("/mnt/data/benchmarks_three_raw.csv")
elas = pd.read_csv("/mnt/data/sensitivity_elasticity_at1_vec.csv")

# ---------- PCA on survivors ----------
# Use numeric knobs; include g_agammagamma for both modes (spectator values are tiny)
cols = ["c1_plus_c3","c2","c4","zetaF_over_MF2","eps_over_Mpsi","g_agammagamma","de_pred","dn_pred"]
X = survivors[cols].copy()

# log-transform strictly-positive columns to handle dynamic range
pos_cols = ["zetaF_over_MF2","eps_over_Mpsi","g_agammagamma","de_pred","dn_pred"]
for c in pos_cols:
    X[c] = np.log10(X[c].clip(lower=1e-300))

# standardize
mu = X.mean(axis=0)
sd = X.std(axis=0).replace(0, 1.0)
Z = (X - mu) / sd

# PCA via SVD
U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(Z.values, full_matrices=False)
explained_var = (S**2) / (len(Z)-1)
explained_ratio = explained_var / explained_var.sum()
loadings = pd.DataFrame(Vt.T, index=cols, columns=[f"PC{i+1}" for i in range(Vt.shape[0])])

# Save PCA results
pca_load_path = "/mnt/data/pca_loadings.csv"
pca_expl_path = "/mnt/data/pca_explained_variance.csv"
loadings.to_csv(pca_load_path)
pd.DataFrame({"PC":[f"PC{i+1}" for i in range(len(explained_ratio))],
              "explained_ratio": explained_ratio}).to_csv(pca_expl_path, index=False)

# Show top-3 PCs with loadings
top3 = loadings.iloc[:, :3].copy()
display_dataframe_to_user("PCA loadings (top 3 PCs) — least/most constrained combos", top3.reset_index().rename(columns={"index":"parameter"}))
display_dataframe_to_user("PCA explained variance ratios", pd.DataFrame({"PC":[f"PC{i+1}" for i in range(len(explained_ratio))],
                                                                        "explained_ratio": explained_ratio}))

# Biplot-ish scatter for PC1 vs PC2
scores = U[:, :2] * S[:2]
plt.figure()
plt.scatter(scores[:,0], scores[:,1], s=4, alpha=0.5)
plt.title("Survivors: PC1 vs PC2")
plt.xlabel("PC1 score")
plt.ylabel("PC2 score")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("/mnt/data/pca_pc1_pc2_scatter.png")
plt.close()

# ---------- Edge projection: push slack gates to bound ----------
# Determine the least-constraining gates from elasticity (lowest values)
elas_sorted = elas.sort_values("elasticity_at_1", ascending=True).reset_index(drop=True)
display_dataframe_to_user("Elasticity ranking (least constrained first)", elas_sorted)

# Map gate names to parameter column and bound accessor
bound_vals = {
    "abs_c1_plus_c3": 1e-17,
    "abs_c2": 1e-8,
    "abs_c4": 1e-8,
    "zetaF_over_MF2": 1e-22,
    "eps_over_Mpsi": 1e-22,
    "g_agammagamma": 5e-12,
    "de_elec": 1.1e-29,
    "dn_neut": 1.8e-26,
}
gate_to_param = {
    "abs_c1_plus_c3": "c1_plus_c3",
    "abs_c2": "c2",
    "abs_c4": "c4",
    "zetaF_over_MF2": "zetaF_over_MF2",
    "eps_over_Mpsi": "eps_over_Mpsi",
    "g_agammagamma": "g_agammagamma",
    "de_elec": "de_pred",
    "dn_neut": "dn_pred",
}

def compute_foms(row):
    return pd.Series({
        "FOM_GW": abs(row["c1_plus_c3"]) / bound_vals["abs_c1_plus_c3"],
        "FOM_c2": abs(row["c2"]) / bound_vals["abs_c2"],
        "FOM_c4": abs(row["c4"]) / bound_vals["abs_c4"],
        "FOM_photon": row["zetaF_over_MF2"] / bound_vals["zetaF_over_MF2"],
        "FOM_fermion": row["eps_over_Mpsi"] / bound_vals["eps_over_Mpsi"],
        "FOM_axion": (0.0 if row["theta4_mode"]=="spectator" else row["g_agammagamma"] / bound_vals["g_agammagamma"]),
        "FOM_d_e": row["de_pred"] / bound_vals["de_elec"],
        "FOM_d_n": row["dn_pred"] / bound_vals["dn_neut"],
    })

# Choose the 2 least-constrained gates
least_two = elas_sorted["gate"].head(2).tolist()

edge_rows = []
for i, row in bench.iterrows():
    before = compute_foms(row)
    after_row = row.copy()
    changed = []
    for g in least_two:
        p = gate_to_param[g]
        if g in ["abs_c1_plus_c3","abs_c2","abs_c4"]:
            # set magnitude to 0.95 * bound with same sign
            sign = 1 if after_row[p] >= 0 else -1
            after_row[p] = sign * (0.95 * bound_vals[g])
        else:
            # set to 0.95 * bound (spectator axion unaffected)
            if g=="g_agammagamma" and after_row["theta4_mode"]=="spectator":
                continue
            after_row[p] = 0.95 * bound_vals[g]
        changed.append((g, p))
    after = compute_foms(after_row)
    delta = after - before
    pack = {"Benchmark": f"BM-{i+1} ({row['theta4_mode']})"}
    for k in before.index:
        pack[f"{k}_before"] = before[k]
        pack[f"{k}_after"] = after[k]
        pack[f"{k}_delta"] = delta[k]
    pack["changed_gates"] = ", ".join([f"{g}->{gate_to_param[g]}" for g in changed]) if changed else "none"
    edge_rows.append(pack)

edge_df = pd.DataFrame(edge_rows)
edge_path = "/mnt/data/edge_projection_results.csv"
edge_df.to_csv(edge_path, index=False)

display_dataframe_to_user("Edge projection (push least-constrained gates to their limits)", edge_df)

print("Artifacts saved:")
print("/mnt/data/pca_loadings.csv")
print("/mnt/data/pca_explained_variance.csv")
print("/mnt/data/pca_pc1_pc2_scatter.png")

    "abs_c1_plus_c3": "c1_plus_c3",
    "abs_c2": "c2",
    "abs_c4": "c4",
    "zetaF_over_MF2": "zetaF_over_MF2",
    "eps_over_Mpsi": "eps_over_Mpsi",
    "g_agammagamma": "g_agammagamma",
    "de_elec": "de_pred",
    "dn_neut": "dn_pred",
}

def compute_foms(row):
    return pd.Series({
        "FOM_GW": abs(row["c1_plus_c3"]) / bound_vals["abs_c1_plus_c3"],
        "FOM_c2": abs(row["c2"]) / bound_vals["abs_c2"],
        "FOM_c4": abs(row["c4"]) / bound_vals["abs_c4"],
        "FOM_photon": row["zetaF_over_MF2"] / bound_vals["zetaF_over_MF2"],
        "FOM_fermion": row["eps_over_Mpsi"] / bound_vals["eps_over_Mpsi"],
        "FOM_axion": (0.0 if row["theta4_mode"]=="spectator" else row["g_agammagamma"] / bound_vals["g_agammagamma"]),

        "FOM_d_n": row["dn_pred"] / bound_vals["dn_neut"],

least_two = elas_sorted["gate"].head(2).tolist()

edge_rows = []
for i, row in bench.iterrows():
    before = compute_foms(row)
    after_row = row.copy()
    changed_text = []
    for g in least_two:

OPERATORS MANUAL — MASTER LAGRANGIAN (FOLIATION + AXION + YM + FERMIONS + TOPOLOGY)
==================================================================================

Central Clean Lagrangian
------------------------
We work in flat spacetime (η = diag(−,+,+,+)). The preferred foliation is defined
by a scalar T(x), with unit-timelike vector u^μ = −∂^μ T / sqrt(−(∂T)^2).
Projector onto spatial slices: Δ^{μν} = η^{μν} + u^μ u^ν.

The clean Lagrangian is:

  L = L_fol + L_theta + L_gauge + L_ferm + L_top

with components:

  L_fol =
    λ ((∂T)^2 + 1)
    + c1 (∂_μ u_ν)(∂^μ u^ν)
    + c2 (∂_μ u^μ)^2
    + (tilde c3 / M_u^2)(Δ^{αβ} ∂_α ∂_β u_μ)^2

  L_theta =
    (Z_⊥/2) Δ^{μν} ∂_μ θ4 ∂_ν θ4
    − (Z_∥/2)(u^μ ∂_μ θ4)^2
    − μ^2 cos(3 θ4)
    + (1 / (2 M_θ^2)) (Δ^{μν} ∂_μ ∂_ν θ4)^2

  L_gauge =
    − 1/4 Σ_I F^I_{μν} F^{I μν}
    + (ζ_F / 2M_F^2) Σ_I (Δ^{μα} Δ^{νβ} F^I_{μν} F^I_{αβ})

  L_ferm =
    Σ_a ψ̄_a (i γ^μ ∂_μ − m_a(θ4)) ψ_a
    − Σ_{a,I} g_I ψ̄_a γ^μ A^I_μ T^I ψ_a
    + Σ_a (ε_a / M_ψ) u_μ ψ̄_a γ^μ ψ_a

  L_top =
    (κ / 32π^2) θ4 Σ_I F^I_{μν} ˜F^{I μν}

Definitions
-----------
- u_μ: preferred timelike unit vector, derived from T.
- Δ^{μν}: spatial projector orthogonal to u^μ.
- θ4: periodic scalar (periodicity 2π/3), potential V(θ4) = μ^2 cos(3θ4).
- m_a(θ4): fermion mass function, respecting discrete symmetry, e.g. m0a + y sin^2 θ4.
- F^I_{μν}: gauge field strengths, with ˜F^I the dual tensor.
- κ: quantized coefficient for axion-like topological term.
- M_•: suppression scales for higher-spatial-derivative operators.

Operator Levels
---------------
We classify operators into levels:

- A (Core): required by symmetries and IR viability (foliation basis, scalar θ4 kinetic & potential, YM, fermion kinetic/gauge, topological axion term).
- B (Soft/technically natural): spurionic Lorentz-violating terms (e.g., u·J for fermions). Allowed, but numerically small; radiatively stable if symmetry protected.
- C (UV regulators): higher-spatial-derivative operators, suppressed by heavy scales. Important for UV stability but negligible in IR.
- D (Topological/discrete): quantized or cohomological terms (axion F ˜F, lattice/BF structures). Invisible in perturbation theory but crucial for global consistency.

Constraint Anchors
------------------
- GW170817: gravitational-wave speed matched to c = 1 → imposes c1 + c3 ≈ 0 (|cT − 1| < 10^-15).
- Solar-System & Pulsars: constrain c2, c4 to |c| ≲ 10^-5–10^-7.
- SME Photon LIV: birefringence bounds |δc/c| down to 10^-15–10^-32 → ζ_F/M_F^2 suppressed.
- SME Fermion LIV: atomic clocks/comagnetometers bound LV currents at 10^-20–10^-30 → ε_a tiny.
- Axion-photon coupling: CAST, PDG: g_{aγγ} ≲ few × 10^-11 GeV^-1 for light axions.
- EDMs: electron EDM |d_e| < 1.1 × 10^-29 e·cm; neutron EDM |d_n| < 1.8 × 10^-26 e·cm.

Usage Guidelines
----------------
- Always enforce u^2 = −1 via λ term.
- Keep Core (A) operators active; include Soft (B) with small coefficients; include UV (C) with large suppression scales; always retain Topological (D).
- When adding gravity, promote η → g, ∂ → ∇, and use Einstein–Æther/Hořava basis (c1–c4 with c13=0).

Baseline Settings
-----------------
- Foliation: c1 + c3 = 0; scan c2, c4 in allowed wedge.
- Scalar θ4: Z_⊥ ≈ Z_∥ in IR; μ set by axion mass or defect tension.
- Gauge: ζ_F → 0 in IR (set M_F large).
- Fermion: ε_a ≈ 0 in IR (set small at matching scale).
- Topological: κ quantized, consistent with anomaly cancellation.

Operator Catalog
----------------
(see constraint_table_master_expanded.csv for full detail: sector, operator, symmetry,
dimensionality, phenomenology, bounds, and baseline setting).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This manual is a living document. Update experimental anchors regularly (PDG,
SME tables, GW observations, EDM bounds, CAST/helioscopes). Keep all symmetry-
allowed operators in the basis; prune only true redundancies (via IBP, EOM, or
constraints).

\section*{SM embedding in foliation + axion framework (flat spacetime)}
\noindent
IR limit assumes approximate Lorentz invariance: $c_1 + c_3 \!=\! 0$, $|c_2|,|c_4|\!\ll\!1$; set $\zeta_F/M_F^2,\ \varepsilon_a/M_\psi \to 0$.
\\[4pt]
\textbf{Field content:} Standard Model gauge group $G_{\rm SM}=SU(3)_c\times SU(2)_L\times U(1)_Y$, chiral fermions $q_L,u_R,d_R,\ell_L,e_R$ (and $\nu_R$ optional), Higgs doublet $H$ (hypercharge $+1/2$), plus foliation clock $T$ and periodic scalar $\theta_4$ (period $2\pi/3$).
\\[6pt]
\textbf{Lagrangian:}
\begin{align}
\mathcal{L} &\;=\; \mathcal{L}_{\text{fol}} + \mathcal{L}_{\theta} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{gauge}}^{\rm SM} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{ferm}}^{\rm SM} + \mathcal{L}_{H} + \mathcal{L}_{Y} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{top}}^{\rm SM}\,.
\\[4pt]
\mathcal{L}_{\text{fol}} &\;=\; \lambda\!\left((\partial T)^2+1\right)
+ c_1(\partial_\mu u_\nu)(\partial^\mu u^\nu)
+ c_2(\partial_\mu u^\mu)^2
+ \frac{\tilde c_3}{M_u^2}\!\left(\Delta^{\alpha\beta}\partial_\alpha\partial_\beta u_\mu\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\theta} &\;=\; \frac{Z_\perp}{2}\Delta^{\mu\nu}\partial_\mu\theta_4\partial_\nu\theta_4
- \frac{Z_\parallel}{2}(u^\mu\partial_\mu\theta_4)^2
- \mu^2\cos(3\theta_4)
+ \frac{1}{2M_\theta^2}\!\left(\Delta^{\mu\nu}\partial_\mu\partial_\nu\theta_4\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{gauge}}^{\rm SM} &\;=\; -\frac14 G^A_{\mu\nu}G^{A\mu\nu}
- \frac14 W^I_{\mu\nu}W^{I\mu\nu}
- \frac14 B_{\mu\nu}B^{\mu\nu},
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{ferm}}^{\rm SM} &\;=\; \sum_{\text{gen}}\Big[\,
\bar q_L i\slashed{D} q_L + \bar u_R i\slashed{D} u_R + \bar d_R i\slashed{D} d_R
+ \bar\ell_L i\slashed{D} \ell_L + \bar e_R i\slashed{D} e_R
+ \bar\nu_R i\slashed{D}\nu_R \Big] ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_H &\;=\; (D_\mu H)^\dagger(D^\mu H) - \lambda_H\!\left(H^\dagger H - \tfrac{v^2}{2}\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_Y &\;=\; - \bar q_L Y_u \tilde H u_R - \bar q_L Y_d H d_R - \bar \ell_L Y_e H e_R
- \tfrac12\, \bar \nu_R^c M_R \nu_R - \bar \ell_L Y_\nu \tilde H \nu_R + \text{h.c.}\,,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\text{top}}^{\rm SM} &\;=\; \frac{\kappa_3}{32\pi^2}\,\theta_4\, G^A_{\mu\nu}\tilde G^{A\mu\nu}
+ \frac{\kappa_2}{32\pi^2}\,\theta_4\, W^I_{\mu\nu}\tilde W^{I\mu\nu}
+ \frac{\kappa_1}{32\pi^2}\,\theta_4\, B_{\mu\nu}\tilde B^{\mu\nu}\,.
\end{align}
\textbf{Definitions:} $u_\mu = -\partial_\mu T / \sqrt{-(\partial T)^2}$, $\Delta^{\mu\nu}=\eta^{\mu\nu}+u^\mu u^\nu$, $\tilde X^{\mu\nu}=\tfrac12\epsilon^{\mu\nu\rho\sigma}X_{\rho\sigma}$, $\tilde H = i\sigma^2 H^*$.
\\[6pt]
\textbf{IR matching conditions (``Known Physics''):}
\begin{itemize}
\item $\langle H\rangle = v/\sqrt{2}$ with $v \simeq 246\ \text{GeV}$; reproduce $m_W = \tfrac12 g_2 v$, $m_Z = \tfrac12 \sqrt{g_1^2+g_2^2}\, v$, photon massless.
\item Choose $Y_{u,d,e,\nu}$ to match observed fermion masses and mixings (CKM, PMNS); $M_R$ large gives see-saw if desired.
\item Set $\zeta_F/M_F^2,\ \varepsilon_a/M_\psi \to 0$ at/near the weak scale; keep $c_1{+}c_3\!=\!0$ and $|c_{2,4}|\!\ll\!1$ so Lorentz tests are satisfied.
\item Either (A) decouple $\theta_4$ from QCD/electroweak ($\kappa_i\!\to\!0$) to make it a spectator, or (B) identify $\theta_4$ as an axion-like field: choose $\kappa_3\neq0$ to address strong CP and ensure domain-wall number $N_{\rm DW}=3$ issues are controlled (e.g.\ by biasing or inflationary history).
\end{itemize}
\textbf{Notes:} Gauge group and chiral content exactly match the SM; foliation operators are irrelevant in the IR if their coefficients satisfy experimental bounds; higher-spatial-derivative terms regulate the UV but do not affect IR observables.
\end{document}

\\[6pt]
\textbf{Lagrangian:}
\begin{align}
\mathcal{L} &\;=\; \mathcal{L}_{\text{fol}} + \mathcal{L}_{\theta} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{gauge}}^{\rm SM} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{ferm}}^{\rm SM} + \mathcal{L}_{H} + \mathcal{L}_{Y} + \mathcal{L}_{\text{top}}^{\rm SM}\,.
\\[4pt]
\mathcal{L}_{\text{fol}} &\;=\; \lambda\!\left((\partial T)^2+1\right)
+ c_1(\partial_\mu u_\nu)(\partial^\mu u^\nu)
+ c_2(\partial_\mu u^\mu)^2
+ \frac{\tilde c_3}{M_u^2}\!\left(\Delta^{\alpha\beta}\partial_\alpha\partial_\beta u_\mu\right)^2 ,
\\
\mathcal{L}_{\theta} &\;=\; \frac{Z_\perp}{2}\Delta^{\mu\nu}\partial_\mu\theta_4\partial_\nu\theta_4
- \frac{Z_\parallel}{2}(u^\mu\partial_\mu\theta_4)^2

+ \bar\ell_L i\slashed{D} \ell_L + \bar e_R i\slashed{D} e_R

OPERATORS MANUAL — MASTER LAGRANGIAN (FOLIATION + AXION + YM + FERMIONS + TOPOLOGY)
==================================================================================

Central Clean Lagrangian
------------------------
We work in flat spacetime (η = diag(−,+,+,+)). The preferred foliation is defined
by a scalar T(x), with unit-timelike vector u^μ = −∂^μ T / sqrt(−(∂T)^2).
Projector onto spatial slices: Δ^{μν} = η^{μν} + u^μ u^ν.

The clean Lagrangian is:

  L = L_fol + L_theta + L_gauge + L_ferm + L_top

with components:

  L_fol =
    λ ((∂T)^2 + 1)
    + c1 (∂_μ u_ν)(∂^μ u^ν)
    + c2 (∂_μ u^μ)^2
    + (tilde c3 / M_u^2)(Δ^{αβ} ∂_α ∂_β u_μ)^2

  L_theta =
    (Z_⊥/2) Δ^{μν} ∂_μ θ4 ∂_ν θ4
    − (Z_∥/2)(u^μ ∂_μ θ4)^2
    − μ^2 cos(3 θ4)
    + (1 / (2 M_θ^2)) (Δ^{μν} ∂_μ ∂_ν θ4)^2

  L_gauge =
    − 1/4 Σ_I F^I_{μν} F^{I μν}
    + (ζ_F / 2M_F^2) Σ_I (Δ^{μα} Δ^{νβ} F^I_{μν} F^I_{αβ})
